content: Tiny ERP (Olist) users on ReclameAqui repeatedly complain about: broken/limited financial reports (filters not working), reporting section lacking specific report types, support that redirects feature requests to a public voting 'ideas' board (4300+ pending ideas) rather than shipping them, stock control issues after Olist acquisition (duplicated orders, manual stock reconciliation), and lack of manufacturing/production-specific functionality. Reporting/BI is a recurring pain point, not fabricated.
